newsitem.title: FRANCE: Alcatel seeks Asian electronics partner.
newsitem.headline: Alcatel seeks Asian electronics partner.

text.p: Alcatel Alsthom, elaborating on its bid for the Thomson group, said on Wednesday it was keen on an Asian partner in consumer electronics to make its products more competitive.

"Alcatel is interested in the opportunities arising from digitalisation, which permits the interconnection with communication networks. Thomson multimedia and Alcatel can capture together new markets which will emerge through the convergence of these two domains," an Alcatel statement said.
"Beyond this, necessary improvements in the competitiveness of current products would be achieved within the framework of a partnership with a major electronics group," it said.
Alcatel said on Wednesday that it had submitted an offer to the government to acquire the Thomson SA electronics and defence group as a whole as part of the privatisation process.
